prologue.description: A pinprick in the dark becomes the Moon as the camera races toward it. A radio signal crackles.
Apollo 11 television footage shows an astronaut beside the lunar module in 1969.
The picture shrinks into a flickering television. On an alien ship, Zorvax springs forward to greet the astronaut.

lines.text: Zorvax: They left Earth! They’re coming!

prologue.description: Nyxen holds up one finger. Zorvax throws his arms wide anyway.

lines.text: Nyxen: Sir, that’s one human.
Zorvax: The first of many!

prologue.description: The cadet fires the party cannon. The lights go rose and teal, foil strips fly, and the crew dances beneath a welcome banner.

lines.text: Zorvax: Cadet!
[Party cannon pops]

prologue.description: One last streamer lodges in the cannon. The cannon coughs twice.

lines.text: [Cannon coughs twice]
Cadet B: Oh, they went back to Earth.

prologue.description: The bridge holds in the same frame. The lights fade and the banner sags. In 2026, 57 years later, the crew is still waiting.

lines.text: Cadet B: Take the banner down?
Zorvax: When they get here.

prologue.description: The CRT lights up. Artemis II flew around the Moon and returned its crew to Earth. Zorvax turns toward the observation window.

lines.text: Zorvax: The Moon? Again?
Nyxen: Then straight back home, sir.

prologue.description: Through the window, Earth rolls out of the night and into the sunlight. Zorvax takes a long look at the planet humans keep coming home to.

lines.text: Zorvax: What does it have that ours doesn’t?
Zorvax: We must bring them here.

prologue.description: In the gloom, Zorvax slams a red switch. Every light on the bridge kicks on.

lines.text: Zorvax: Commence mission: The Great Homecoming.

briefing.description: Nyxen activates a miniature Earth on the research bench, then points to a weather control.

lines.text: Nyxen: A working copy of Earth.
Nyxen: Try this dial.

ending.description: Zorvax holds up the report and trips the party cannon as he declares victory. Golden fireworks form a V above the crew. Cadet B hurries in with the archive cartridge.

lines.text: Zorvax: After 57 years, we have finally made Earth uninhabitable!

ending.description: Nyxen stops the celebration and directs everyone's attention to the big monitor behind the crew. The saved simulation appears. Cadet B docks the archive cartridge, adding the historical finding. Zorvax taps the reader, and the monitor switches to the latest saved experiments.

lines.text: Nyxen: Sir, these were computer simulations.
Nyxen: Sir, these are weather records.
Nyxen: Sir, these were computer simulations.

ending.description: Nyxen lets the data speak for a moment. Zorvax slowly looks away from the monitor and back toward you. Cadet B takes a step back from the party cannon.

lines.text: Zorvax: …
Nyxen: We haven’t actually changed anything on Earth.
Zorvax: So… we need more research.

ending.description: The jammed streamer stays put. The last party balloon deflates next to the cannon.

lines.text: [Balloon squeaks]
